# Vendored Postman schema

`collection-v2.1.0.json` is the Postman Collection Format v2.1.0 JSON Schema,
published at <https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json>
(from <https://github.com/postmanlabs/schemas>, Apache License 2.0). It is used
only by the export tests to validate `rustman export postman` output; it is not
a runtime dependency.
